reason: No cited evidence is provided to support any of the key premises. The claims about mapping microstructural descriptors to properties, ML interpolation of mechanical behavior, embedding physics-based constraints, and specific gains in accuracy and efficiency are all unsupported by prior work.
premises: Microstructural descriptors from imaging can be quantitatively mapped to bulk mechanical properties
ML models can interpolate stress-strain and fracture behavior from microstructural data
Physics-based constraints can be embedded in ML to capture damage initiation and propagation
